limitations: Model card specifies yolov5 7.0.6; retained installed 7.0.14 for a controlled native-workflow comparison, not historical environment reproduction.
Model card demonstration parameters are not its published validation protocol. Use installed native val defaults conf=0.001, iou=0.6, max_det=300.
FP32 retained from previous evaluation; native val.run otherwise defaults to FP16.
Native COCO-to-YOLO conversion requires one-based source categories: map original category 0 to 1 only for conversion, producing YOLO class 0. Original COCO annotations remain unchanged.
Official validation example uses batch=256; local batch defaults to 16 for memory use and is explicitly recorded. FP32 is retained.
Reference is upstream YOLOv10-N, not an independently published accuracy measurement by the HF mirror. Weight SHA256 is recorded; byte identity to upstream release is not certified.
End-to-end YOLOv10 native validator handles postprocessing; no additional NMS is added.
Model card specifies ultralytics 8.0.4 and ultralyticsplus 0.0.14. Retained 8.4.0 with direct local checkpoint loading, as in the accepted M04/M07 controlled workflow comparisons.
Native val replaces per-image predict plus external scoring; not a complete historical environment reproduction.
